name: 47246 · Hope, IN
findings: ZIP 47246 (Hope) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 47246 (Hope) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
57% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 47246 (Hope) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 47246 (Hope) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).
